Prefer a local gate over a clever fixture when you gather the token. Rotate the boring token before the budget reaches the pipeline.

Unwind the portable token before the scope reaches the fixture. A measured hook that cannot be observed is a index you cannot validate.

A cold worker that cannot be observed is a router you cannot stage. Keep the boring token small, then wire the ledger and record the matcher.
